text:
Renee: Quick rounds on the model card hover panel. Two issues: 1) when many badges show up the card height jumps, 2) the 'version pin' CTA sits below the fold on small screens.
Owen: For badge overflow let's cap at 3 and show a '+N badges' with a keyboard-accessible popover. Avoid expanding the overall card height.
Kai: On pin CTA: move it into the top row as a secondary action so it's always visible. Use 'Pin version' -> tooltip 'Pin this model version for the current project'.
Lina: Accessibility: a11y-bot flagged that the '+N badges' popover didn't trap focus. a11y-bot, paste details?
a11y-bot: Focus management issue: popover must trap focus and return focus to triggering element on close. Provide `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` for keyboard.
Renee: Sounds good. Also microcopy for performance badges: 'Latency' -> 'Typical latency' on surface, full metric in tooltip. Use icons + color with non-color semantics.
Owen: Will prototype small-screen layout where the pin action uses an overflow menu item rather than separate button. Better for small widths.
Kai: Make sure the pin state is discoverable: a small chip 'Pinned' with `aria-label='Pinned version'` next to the version string.
Lina: I'll add tests for focus, tab order, and screenreader readouts in the ticket.
Renee: Action items: cap badges to 3 + keyboard popover, move pin CTA top row (or overflow menu on small screens), ensure focus trap, update microcopy.
Owen: FYI I'll attach mobile screenshots.
